summary.text: Shannon Lundgren is a Republican state representative from Iowa House District 65 who is seeking re-election in the November 3, 2026 general election.
Ballotpedia lists Lundgren's career experience in travel and hospitality, including owning Lone Palm Travel Co. and Trackside Bar & Grill.

paragraphs.text: Shannon Lundgren was born in Dubuque, Iowa, and graduated from Wahlert Catholic High School, according to Ballotpedia.
Lundgren earned an associate degree in travel and hospitality from the Midwest Travel and Hospitality Institute.

Lundgren's career experience includes owning Lone Palm Travel Co. and Trackside Bar & Grill and working as the residence director of the Dubuque Retirement Community, the general manager of the Dubuque County Fair Association, and a sales manager with Eagle Ridge Inn & Resort.
Lundgren has been affiliated with the Dubuque Area Chamber of Commerce, the Dyersville Chamber of Commerce, and the Dubuque County Farm Bureau.
Ballotpedia dates Lundgren's tenure in the Iowa House to 2017.
Lundgren also ran for the U.S. House in Iowa's 2nd Congressional District but did not appear on the Republican primary ballot on June 2, 2026.

In the 2025-2026 session Lundgren chaired the House Commerce Committee and was assigned to the House Human Resources, Administration, House State Government and House Ways and Means committees, the Health Policy Oversight Committee and the Legislative Council.
